name: Ancestor's Call summons the Honored Ancestor and appears once in the spellbook (#168)
contract: Issue #168: a Draenei Barbarian casting Ancestor's Call 804834 sees the cast animation but nothing is summoned, and the button appears twice. Ancestry talent 804729 (CharacterAdvancement 31153, spec 3 ANCESTRY) reads 'Teaches you Ancestor's Call.@s:804834:0@'; AscensionTaughtAbilityData.h { 12, 3, 0, 804729, 804834 } grants 804834 as a temporary spell through SynchronizeTaughtAbilities while spec 3 is active. 804834 (Rank 'Troll') describes 'Call an Honored Ancestor to aid you in battle until dismissed'; its only effect is SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON_PET (56) with MiscValue 51265, and AscensionBarbarian::Ancestor accepts exactly that entry in the guardian pet slot. The CoA database mirror (hertigservices/ascension-data, supplemental/exiles-db npc 51265) lists 51265 as 'Honored Ancestor' with display 173031, a troll model, but no world SQL defined the entry, so Player::SummonPet failed with 'No such creature entry 51265'. Expected: one cast leaves one living Honored Ancestor 51265 owned by the Barbarian as its pet, for a Draenei as for any race (the client data has Troll, Human, Dwarf, Orc, Undead and Tauren variants 804834/804846/804869/804872/804901/804905 but none for Draenei, and the server teaches only 804834). The duplicate button came from Player::learnSpell announcing a temporary grant a second time after Player::_addSpell had already sent SMSG_LEARNED_SPELL, fixed by b2bdf72a5 (#436, #251): learning the talent must announce Ancestor's Call to the client exactly once.

steps.label: AscensionTaughtAbilityData.h gates Ancestor's Call on the Ancestry specialization 3
Baseline: Ancestor's Call is not known
Learn the Ancestry talent that teaches Ancestor's Call
The client is told about Ancestor's Call once, so the spellbook holds one button
Ancestor's Call summons one Honored Ancestor
The Honored Ancestor is the Barbarian's pet, where AscensionBarbarian::Ancestor looks
